limitations: Previously reused development data only: 50 seen and 25 development-unseen classes, 500 images. No model updates, image filtering, final-set access, new backbone, per-class weights, or post-result expansion of the search. Cross-fitting does not undo earlier development-set reuse. Paired class-bootstrap intervals condition on the trained models and selected out-of-fold predictions; they do not repeat weight selection or represent an independent confirmatory test.
